finding: Status model runs on server-side millisecond timers: 35 synced booleans and one synced stack number (poisonStacks), so the client never receives time left (app/models/colyseus-models/status.ts)
Poison stacks cap at 3 by default, 4 with venomous, 5 with toxic; each tick is 5 percent of max HP per stack every 1000 ms (status.ts triggerPoison ~579, updatePoison ~624)
Freeze and sleep do not stack; a fixed 1500 ms control immunity window opens when either ends (status.ts triggerFreeze, triggerSleep; app/config/game/game.ts:6)
Charm forces movement toward the charmer until one cell away; each hit from the charmer removes 500 ms (app/core/moving-state.ts:24; app/core/pokemon-entity.ts ~1231)

While flinched a shield absorbs only half of each hit; every tenth block knocks an adjacent attacker to a safe cell and deals the blocker's attack back (app/core/pokemon-state.ts:590; app/core/effects/synergies.ts:327)

Client adds one animated badge per true status from the status atlas, poison switches to a heavier animation at 3 stacks, and each synced field change dispatches presentation (app/public/src/game/components/pokemon-sprite.ts 950-1003, 1364; battle-manager.ts 200-260). Art not viewed

Items and passives grant specific status immunities (Flame Orb freeze, X-Ray Vision sleep, Vigoroth sleep, Comatose burn, poison, freeze, paralysis); berries cure on apply (app/core/effects/items.ts 829-864; passives.ts 1293-1310)
Six major statuses are exclusive through trySetStatus; a volatile with no restart hook keeps its first timer (sim/pokemon.ts 1669, 1969; data/conditions.ts)
Paralysis is a 1-in-4 cannot-move roll with half speed unless Quick Feet; frozen thaws on a 1-in-5 roll per turn (data/conditions.ts 20-46, 83-122)
Burn takes 1/16 max HP per residual and halves physical damage; poison takes 1/8; tox adds a stage each residual up to 15 (data/conditions.ts 2-18, 123-161; sim/battle-actions.ts 1803)
Sleep counter is random(2,5) and confusion random(2,6); the sim random is half-open, so these give 2-4 and 2-5 (data/conditions.ts 47-82, 162-197; sim/prng.ts 94-101)
Stat stages clamp at -6 and +6 with a multiplier table from 1 to 4 (sim/pokemon.ts 583-590, 1210-1219)

Synchronize reflects a status back to its source except sleep and freeze; Insomnia and grounded terrains block statuses, with messages only on some causes (data/abilities.ts 2176, 4860; data/moves.ts 4516, 12170)
